**Stable ID:** `DATA-08.02` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 08 Evaluation integrity and comparability

Record how hidden test sets, private leaderboards and held-out data are governed without exposing them.

## Deliverables

- Hidden-test governance fields
- Prohibitions on copying hidden items

## Canonical artifact paths

- `docs/PUBLICATION_POLICY.md`
- `schemas/benchmark.schema.json`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Hidden-test policies cite the benchmark owner's published rules

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Hidden-test status, submission channel and owner are recorded
- [ ] No hidden item or answer key is stored
- [ ] Policy prohibits leaking held-out data

## Non-goals
